correctness.rationale: The admissible projection condition is proved equivalent to degree-(Q−1) homogeneous interpolation; a nonzero augmented Vandermonde determinant has degree Q(Q−1)/2; every external F_Q-line divides it via h^(Q−1), and the number of such distinct factors equals that degree. Exact conic secant counts determine the admissible open and its A¹-bundle decomposition and zeta function. The proof covers all prime powers Q≥2; six finite-field checks serve only as independent reproducible sanity checks.
